purpose: Drop-in button that drives the full async feedback lifecycle with visual states: idle → pending (spinner) → success (checkmark, auto-reset) | error (X icon, auto-reset) → idle.
uiRules: Uses shresta-btn-success and shresta-btn-error CSS classes (defined in globals.css) for the pop/shake entry animations.
Icons: Loader2 (spinning) for pending, Check for success, XCircle for error — all from lucide-react.
Storefront variant matches the wine-700→wine-900 gradient pill CTA style with 700ms transitions.
Admin variants map to .admin-button, .admin-button.secondary, and .admin-button.danger CSS classes.
Omit variant to bring a fully custom className with no preset styles.
The button is automatically disabled while pending to prevent double-submission.
businessRules: onAction must be a function returning Promise<void>; resolve = success, reject = error.
pendingLabel overrides children while the action is in-flight.
successLabel (default 'Done!') and errorLabel (default 'Try again') are shown for resetAfterMs (default 2000 ms) then auto-reset.
The global button:not([disabled]):active rule in globals.css already provides tactile press feedback; FeedbackButton adds the async outcome layer on top.
For buttons whose success/failure state requires custom rendering, use useFeedback directly instead of FeedbackButton.
